maskMethodology.threshold: At least one RGB channel changes by more than 8/255 for a pixel to be marked.
maskMethodology.antialiasing: The threshold excludes low-level edge/noise variations; marked edges still include antialiasing where a channel crosses the threshold.
maskMethodology.shadowsAndOcclusion: Masks include any framebuffer changes caused by visibility exclusion, including shadow/depth consequences; they are not exact mesh silhouettes or per-layer IDs.
maskMethodology.interactionMask: No pairwise transparent interaction mask was generated: the initial inventories contained no T5 projected-rectangle overlap candidates, and the explicit-transparent group did not justify escalation. Candidate masks remain conservative and do not prove physical overlap.
maskMethodology.backgroundControl: M2 is the complement of the within-renderer all-renderables observed-differential mask. It is an unaffected/background candidate, not proof that every pixel is background. The independently sampled 32×32 top-left canvas patch is checked before and after exclusion and cross-backend.
